reviewer.independence: The reviewer did not edit the rules, calibration, production builder, source corpus, descriptor, README or generated datapack. The reviewer used a separately authored read-only reconstruction program and wrote only this audit and its Markdown projection.
limitations: Independent analytical assurance, not third-party assurance or qualified UK legal-practitioner sign-off.
The semantic review uses title evidence and deterministic corpus scans. It does not claim exhaustive expert legal classification of all 22,299 relationships.
Exact reviewer and rule-authoring model deployment identifiers and billable Codex task usage are not exposed.
The candidate files were uncommitted when assessed; hashes, counts and semantic roots bind this decision.
The authored model-run schema passed. Its generated bundle/whole-law mirror was still the preceding schema at audit time and must be regenerated before release.

Checked identifiers, duplicates, source joins, topic joins, literal evidence, authority, derivation, review status, verification, rights and freshness.
calibration: Independently replayed all 55 rule positives and all 55 near-miss negatives.
Independently replayed all 58 end-to-end cases, including all 16 actual-corpus hard negatives.
Confirmed zero false-positive or false-negative calibration assertions and 100% literal evidence support.

stratified_sample.selection: For each emitting rule, select the ten lowest SHA-256(source NUL rule_id) assertions, or every assertion if the rule emitted fewer than ten.
stratified_sample.qualification: A deterministic stratified review is evidence across every rule/topic slice, not a binomial random sample or exhaustive legal opinion.

findings.title: Generated model-run schema mirror must be synchronized
findings.what_failed: At audit time bundle/whole-law/schemas/model-enrichment-run.schema.json still required the preceding prompt_hash and flat count fields, while the corrected run uses prompt_basis_hash and grain-separated counts.
findings.why_it_matters: The authored run and schema agree, but the public generated mirror would reject the run until the Whole-Law publication is rebuilt.
remediation: Regenerate the Whole-Law publication from the authored schema.
Validate the public run against the regenerated mirror before release.
findings.release_effect: integration gate, not a rejection of the hash-bound enrichment candidate

findings.title: Model-authoring provenance remains explicitly partial
findings.what_failed: The exact interactive rule-authoring transcript, model deployment, sampling parameters and Codex task usage are unavailable from the task surface.
findings.why_it_matters: Rule execution is reproducible and hash-bound, but the earlier model-assisted rule-authoring event is not fully reproducible.
findings.mitigation: The run correctly names prompt_basis_hash, preserves the governed basis and rule/calibration hashes, and records explicit unavailable reasons without fabricating values.

findings.title: Nine governed rules emit no assertion in this snapshot
findings.what_failed: R002, R007, R014, R017, R024, R036, R042, R045 and R047 emit no assertion after matching and suppression; R007 has no corpus include hit.
findings.why_it_matters: This does not affect emitted data. Published per-rule counters correctly distinguish synthetic rule coverage, raw corpus matches, suppression and actual output.

findings.title: Mixed-parent-title discovery remains a disclosed ambiguity
findings.what_failed: Forty emitted R008 titles cite the multi-subject Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012. Clear criminal-subject suffixes are excluded, but generic commencement/consequential titles do not identify which provisions they operate.
findings.why_it_matters: The relationship is useful as a non-exclusive discovery link to a work under the named Act, but title-only evidence cannot prove that each child instrument operates legal-aid provisions.
findings.mitigation: Keep the links non-official and non-exclusive, expose the literal evidence, and prefer provision-level/full-text evidence in a future enrichment generation.

required_before_release: Regenerate bundle/whole-law so its model-run schema mirror equals the authored schema.
Run the complete legislation, Whole-Law, checksum and release-assurance validators against the integrated candidate.
Preserve this exact candidate or obtain a new independent audit after any enrichment rebuild.
